hooks.command: in=$(cat); f=$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); s=$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); case "$f" in *design-system-2.0*) touch "/tmp/claude-ds-check-$s" ;; esac

in=$(cat); f=$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); s=$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.session_id // empty'); case "$f" in *src/pages/*|*src/styles/*|*src/components/*) m="/tmp/claude-ds-check-$s"; if [ ! -f "$m" ]; then jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Per project CLAUDE.md: read design-system-2.0/ds/context.json (and needed DS module files under design-system-2.0/ds/) before editing UI files under src/pages, src/styles, or src/components. Read it now, then retry this edit. (Skip this if you already fetched DS context via a slash command like /new-page, /new-component, /new-react-component, /ux-review, /persona-check, or /audit-page in this session.)"}}'; fi ;; esac

in=$(cat); u=$(echo "$in" | jq -r '.tool_input.url // empty'); case "$u" in *design-system-2.0*) jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"PreToolUse",permissionDecision:"deny",permissionDecisionReason:"Per project CLAUDE.md: the design system is local, never WebFetch. Read the matching file under design-system-2.0/ds/ in this repo instead (same path, no https://anthu211.github.io/ prefix)."}}' ;; esac
